headline: Organic growth drives another full-year guidance raise
summary_short: Quest Diagnostics posted Q2 FY2026 revenue of $3.04 billion, up 10.2% y/y on 13.1% requisition volume growth, with GAAP diluted EPS of $2.84 (+15.0% y/y) and adjusted diluted EPS of $3.12 (+19.1% y/y).
summary_long: Revenue rose 10.2% y/y to $3.04B, almost entirely organic, on 13.1% requisition volume growth (mix pulled revenue-per-requisition down 2.8%). Reported operating margin fell 80bp to 15.1% as cost of services outgrew revenue; adjusted operating margin fell 40bp to 16.5%. Net income rose 13.4% to $320M; diluted EPS $2.84 (+15.0%), adjusted diluted EPS $3.12 (+19.1%). Cash from operations was $597M; capex $138M. Cash and equivalents rose to $626M from $420M at year-end, aided by $494M of new borrowings and $100M of buybacks. Quest raised full-year 2026 guidance: revenue to $11.95B-$12.05B (from $11.78B-$11.90B) and adjusted diluted EPS to $11.05-$11.25 (from $10.63-$10.83).

Full-year capex guidance is unchanged at approximately $550 million in both the prior and updated columns of the guidance table, treated as 'held' rather than silence since the release states both figures side by side.

drivers.explanation: Growth was almost entirely organic (+10.0% of the +10.2% total), driven by 13.1% requisition-volume growth across physician, hospital and consumer channels; revenue per requisition fell 2.8% on test mix.
Reported operating margin fell 80bp y/y to 15.1% (adjusted -40bp to 16.5%) because cost of services grew 10.9% y/y, faster than revenue's 10.2%; the release states no other cause.

Net income grew 13.4%, ahead of operating income's 4.6%, aided by lower net interest expense and equity-method income; adjusted net income grew 17.3% after excluding restructuring, amortization and other items per the company's reconciliation.
Management raised full-year 2026 revenue and EPS guidance, citing robust top- and bottom-line growth and sustained demand for diagnostic insights.
